rows=[int(x) for x in open('/challenge/qr_code.txt').read().split()]
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
for inv in (0,1):
    g=np.array([[ (r>>(28-i))&1 for i in range(29)] for r in rows])
    if inv:g=1-g
    img=Image.fromarray((g*255).astype('uint8')).resize((290,290),Image.NEAREST)
    img=Image.fromarray(np.pad(np.array(img),40,constant_values=255))
    img.save(f'/work/q{inv}.png')
print(open('/dev/null').read())
for r in rows[:8]:print(format(r,'029b').replace('0',' ').replace('1','#'))

rows=[int(x) for x in open('/challenge/qr_code.txt').read().split()]
N=29
g=[[(r>>(N-1-i))&1 for i in range(N)] for r in rows]
# format info
bits=[g[8][i] for i in (0,1,2,3,4,5,7,8)]+[g[i][8] for i in (7,5,4,3,2,1,0)]
# standard: bits 14..0 ; read first copy
f=[g[i][8] for i in (0,1,2,3,4,5,7,8)]+[g[8][j] for j in (7,5,4,3,2,1,0)]
v=0
for b in f:v=(v<<1)|b
v^=0x5412
print(bin(v),(v>>13)&3,(v>>10)&7)
mask=(v>>10)&7
mf=[lambda r,c:(r+c)%2==0,lambda r,c:r%2==0,lambda r,c:c%3==0,lambda r,c:(r+c)%3==0,
lambda r,c:(r//2+c//3)%2==0,lambda r,c:(r*c)%2+(r*c)%3==0,lambda r,c:((r*c)%2+(r*c)%3)%2==0,lambda r,c:((r+c)%2+(r*c)%3)%2==0][mask]
func=[[False]*N for _ in range(N)]
for r in range(9):
    for c in range(9):func[r][c]=True
for r in range(9):
    for c in range(N-8,N):func[r][c]=True
for r in range(N-8,N):
    for c in range(9):func[r][c]=True
for i in range(N):func[6][i]=func[i][6]=True
for r in range(20,25):
    for c in range(20,25):func[r][c]=True
out=[];up=True;c=N-1
while c>0:
    if c==6:c-=1
    rr=range(N-1,-1,-1) if up else range(N)
    for r in rr:
        for cc in (c,c-1):
            if not func[r][cc]:
                out.append(g[r][cc]^(1 if mf(r,cc) else 0))
    up=not up;c-=2
by=[int(''.join(map(str,out[i:i+8])),2) for i in range(0,len(out)-7,8)]
print(by[:60])
bs=''.join(format(b,'08b') for b in by)
print(bs[:4],int(bs[4:12],2))
n=int(bs[4:12],2)
print(bytes(int(bs[12+8*i:20+8*i],2) for i in range(n)))
